auditSample.textSample: Saturdays in Vienna are so much fun! So I highly recommend taking the trip out to visit the different buschenkrank and heruigens that surround Vienna! It’s such a cool way to taste different vintages, and try locally made sausages, pastries, and one of my favorite beverages- Sturm! It’s really easy to take local transportation to and from, and there are a few different routes you can follow. They also have a couple of days each year- the Wiener Wandertag, where everyone goes out o this path and it’s a whole thing! Usually towards the end of September! And then I finished with a great meal at Heunisch & Erben- phenomenal meal and service! Honestly, this was my perfect Saturday! #vienna #trave

Tämä Sacher vie kielen mennessään 🤎 Voin sanoa, Wienin parasta Sacheria. Pehmeää, hyvin kostutettua, suussa sulavaa. Olen käynyt pari kertaa aikaisemmin kuuluisassa Café Sacherissa, mutta ei vedä vertoja Demelille. Café Sacherin torttupala on kuiva ja pinta kova. Mutta Demel….suosittelen. Ovat herkkuja loihtineet jo vuodesta 1786. Kahvila on muutenkin kaunis kuin koru. ”Welcome to Demel - home of the finest cakes, chocolates and sweets in the heart of Vienna. A cultural and culinary institution, our traditional coffee house has been tempting locals and travellers alike since 1786” #cafedemel #demel #sachercake #vienna #wien
